notes: PRIME's own biography card (Change In Spades): Bio names a third party, 'the former Custom CHAOS Champion of FUSE Vance Raymes' (PRIME 405) -- a bystander mention of another character's FUSE title, not this bio's own claim, but still names sccw-2005's own registered title. FUSE resolves to Sin City Championship Wrestling (sccw-2005). No held sccw-2005 document names Change In Spades specifically; the claim is recorded here as the bio's own, and no tenure is minted.

name: Osaka Street Cutters
caption: Mach Hawke and Mamoru Azuma brought the Osaka Street Cutters to PRIME for three shows in January and February 2010.

name: Crudely Civilized

tenures.note: Dated by its title reign in the federation's own title history; no surviving show of the federation bills it.

caption: Tony Rolo and Joey Troy held the Tag Team Title as Crudely Civilized from 12 March to 24 July 2004.

name: CLIQUE CLIQUE BOOM~!

caption: Karina Wolfenden and Tessa Windsor won the Tag Team Title as CLIQUE CLIQUE BOOM~! on 2 February 2005, and the belt was vacated within weeks.

name: Deus Oraculum

tenures.note: Dated by its title reign in the federation's own title history, and by the review of ReVolution 34 (9 June 2004), which shows Joshua Taro Freedom, Poet and Black Angel in the Deus Oraculum dressing room.

caption: Black Angel and JTF held the Tag Team Title as Deus Oraculum from 24 July to 13 October 2004.

name: Team Zambo

tenures.role: tag team of Dave Gibson and Azala Zameer, the #1 contenders to the Tag Team Titles
tenures.note: Billed as a tag team of Dave Gibson and Azala Zameer in the ReVolution of 22 June 2005, where it beats Teh Pwn, and on 5 July 2005, where it loses the Tag Team Title match to Los Diablos.

caption: The tag team of Dave Gibson and Azala Zameer, #1 contenders to the Tag Team Titles in the summer of 2005.

name: East/West Connection

tenures.role: tag team announcing its arrival on 9 June 2004
tenures.note: Corbin Trent and Ryutaro Jiro, hired after a tour of End Game, announce on 9 June 2004 that they will debut at ReVolution 35 to give PRIME a real tag team.

caption: Corbin Trent and Ryutaro Jiro, the tag team that promised Western Power and Eastern Grace.

name: The Dark Age

tenures.note: Vampir Nosferatu's stable in PRIME, formed after The Great American Nightmare of 17 November 2004: the review of 1 December 2004 calls it 'the formidable new Dark Age group', with Shadow and Ozric Mortimer aligned alongside Vampir Nosferatu and Dani Furher, and Tiamat as Vampir's disciple. That night, after the steel cage main event, it electrifies the cage, cuffs Black Angel to it and cuts a pentagram into Paul Cain's chest with the knife it had used the week before on Boda and Emilio Rage; on 15 December 2004 it abducts Ignatius Lisieux and raises him on a cross above a burning Christmas tree. Vampir, its founder, had been one of the original members of PCW's Dark Age of 2001, a different stable.

caption: Vampir Nosferatu's PRIME stable of late 2004, which carved Paul Cain and crucified Ignatius Lisieux.

identity.note: Not PCW's Dark Age of 2001 continued: PRIME's own review of 1 December 2004 calls this 'the formidable new Dark Age group', formed 'since last week' in another federation three years on, and of the PCW lineup (Clyde, DarkStar, Stryfe, Vampir Nosferatu, The End, Skylar Green) only its founder Vampir Nosferatu carries over. A shared founder and name do not make one unit (the rename-vs-successor test, GAVELS 2026-10-06 and D413).
A shared stable name with no document tying the two; kept distinct under the no-merge default.
